title: От Луки 10 — Luke 10
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: God's Kingdom has come near to you.
cases.explain: Царство is the grammatical subject of the sentence — the thing that 'is near' — so it stays in the nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Я видел, как сатана упал с ___, словно молния.
cases.translation: I saw Satan fall from heaven like lightning.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning 'down from' takes the genitive → неба.

cases.sentence: В каждый из ___ и в каждое место Он сам собирался прийти.
cases.translation: …into every one of the cities and every place where he was about to come.
cases.explain: The preposition из ('out of', 'one of') governs the genitive; here the genitive plural городов — 'each one of the cities'.

cases.sentence: На следующий день он дал ___ гостиницы два динария.
cases.translation: On the next day he gave the innkeeper two denarii.
cases.explain: The verb дать (to give) puts the recipient in the dative; хозяину is who receives the money.

cases.sentence: Чтобы он выслал работников на свою ___.
cases.translation: …that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
cases.explain: На + accusative marks the goal here ('out onto his harvest'); жатву is the accusative singular of жатва.

cases.sentence: Моя сестра оставила всю ___ на меня одну.
cases.translation: My sister has left all the work to me alone.
cases.explain: Работа is the direct object of оставила (left) → accusative работу.

cases.sentence: Он подошел и перевязал его раны, промыв их ___ и вином.
cases.translation: He came to him and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine.
cases.explain: The instrumental marks the means used to treat the wounds — 'washed with oil and wine' → маслом.

cases.sentence: Но Тиру и Сидону будет легче на ___, чем вам.
cases.translation: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
cases.explain: На + prepositional marks a fixed event or state ('at the judgment') → суде.

reading.ru: После этого Господь назначил еще семьдесят учеников и послал их по два впереди себя, в каждый из городов и в каждое место, куда Он сам собирался прийти.
reading.question: How did the Lord send out the seventy disciples?
options: Two by two, ahead of him into every town he planned to visit
Alone, to preach in the temple
In groups of twelve, like the apostles
reading.correct: Two by two, ahead of him into every town he planned to visit
reading.explain: The Lord appointed seventy and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place he intended to visit.

reading.ru: Не берите с собой ни кошелька, ни сумки, ни сандалий, и по дороге никого не приветствуйте.
reading.question: What were the seventy told not to bring with them?
options: A purse, a bag, or sandals
reading.correct: A purse, a bag, or sandals
reading.explain: They were told to carry no purse, no bag, no sandals, and to greet no one on the road.

reading.ru: Если вы войдете в город, и вас там примут, то ешьте все, что вам предложат, исцеляйте их больных, которые там есть, и говорите им.
reading.question: What were the disciples told to do if a town welcomed them?
options: Eat what is offered, heal the sick, and announce that God's kingdom is near
Refuse all food out of caution
Stay only one night then leave immediately
reading.correct: Eat what is offered, heal the sick, and announce that God's kingdom is near
reading.explain: If received, they should eat what is set before them, heal the sick there, and tell them God's Kingdom has come near.

reading.ru: Горе тебе, Хоразин! Горе тебе, Вифсаида!
reading.question: Which two towns does Jesus pronounce 'woe' upon?
reading.explain: Jesus says, "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida!"

reading.ru: Семьдесят учеников возвратились к Иисусу радостные.
reading.question: How did the seventy feel when they returned to Jesus?
reading.explain: The seventy returned to Jesus full of joy.

reading.ru: Я видел, как сатана упал с неба, словно молния
reading.question: What vision did Jesus describe after the seventy reported their success?
options: Satan falling from heaven like lightning
A dove descending from the sky
Fire coming down on a city
An angel appearing at a tomb
reading.correct: Satan falling from heaven like lightning
reading.explain: Jesus said, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven."

reading.ru: Потом он повернулся к своим ученикам и сказал так, чтобы слышали только они.
reading.question: What did Jesus do before telling the disciples that their eyes were blessed?
options: He turned to his disciples and spoke privately so only they could hear
He addressed the whole crowd publicly
He sent his disciples away first
He asked the Pharisees to leave
reading.correct: He turned to his disciples and spoke privately so only they could hear
reading.explain: He turned to his disciples and spoke privately, so that only they would hear.

reading.ru: Тут встал один учитель закона и задал Иисусу вопрос, чтобы испытать его.
reading.question: Who approaches Jesus at the start of the parable of the Good Samaritan?
options: An expert in the law, testing Jesus
A blind beggar asking for healing
reading.correct: An expert in the law, testing Jesus
reading.explain: A certain expert in the law stood up and put Jesus to the test.

reading.ru: Случайно по той же дороге проходил священник, и, увидев этого человека, прошел мимо, по другой стороне дороги.
reading.question: What did the priest do when he saw the wounded man on the road?
options: He passed by on the other side
He stopped and bandaged his wounds
He carried him to an inn
He called for help from the town
reading.correct: He passed by on the other side
reading.explain: By chance a priest was going down that road, and when he saw the man he passed by on the other side.

reading.ru: Он подошел и перевязал его раны, промыв их маслом и вином.
reading.question: How did the Samaritan treat the wounded man's injuries?
options: He bandaged the wounds, pouring on oil and wine
He gave him medicine and left
He simply carried him away without treatment
He called a physician from the next town
reading.correct: He bandaged the wounds, pouring on oil and wine
reading.explain: The Samaritan came to him, bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine.

reading.ru: Мария выбрала лучшее, и это у нее не отнимется
reading.question: What did Jesus say about Mary's choice at the end of the chapter?
options: She chose the good part, which will not be taken from her
She should have helped Martha instead
She would be rewarded with riches
reading.correct: She chose the good part, which will not be taken from her
reading.explain: Jesus said Mary had chosen the good part, which would not be taken away from her.
